query_snapshot: For potassium hydroxide solution below 70 percent, which barriers does the archived NIOSH table place in its 8-hour group and which in its 4-hour group?
final_answer:
Evidence-grounded answer:

- For potassium hydroxide (solution < 70%), the archived NIOSH table lists Butyl, Natural, Nitrile, PVC, and Viton in the 8-hour group. [NIOSH Recommendations for Chemical Protective ...: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/ncpc/azncpc.html]
- For potassium hydroxide (solution < 70%), the archived NIOSH table lists Teflon and PE/EVAL in the 4-hour group. [NIOSH Recommendations for Chemical Protective ...: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/ncpc/azncpc.html]
